title: Sr. Energy Cost Reduction Analyst, Charging
description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla’s Supercharger network is one of the world’s leading fast-charging systems. It supports everyday charging and long-distance travel for Tesla vehicles and other EVs, making affordable, reliable energy access essential to electric mobility.
  
  
In this role, you will reduce the cost of energy for Tesla’s Charging network across North America and help accelerate the transition to electrified transportation. You will develop analytical tools to identify cost-saving opportunities, support pricing and strategic decisions, and explore new commercial and technology-driven ways to reduce costs. You will also define the energy procurement strategy, lead tenders and contract negotiations, and build strong relationships with energy suppliers and related stakeholders. In parallel, you will work with internal teams on energy policy and regulatory topics at EU and national level.

* Lead competitive electricity procurement in deregulated markets—from supplier request for proposal and bid evaluation through contract negotiation and award—and evaluate utility proposals, service agreements, and new rate programs to negotiate terms that lower long-term cost
* Analyze solar and battery storage at Supercharger sites; model bill savings, demand charge reduction, and payback to prioritize deployment, and measure realized savings of installed systems
* Maximize revenue from clean fuel credit programs by identifying eligible sites, tracking enrollment, validating credit models, and quantifying financial impact
